entries.zh: 马衣；鞍褥（覆于马背的布垫）
entries.en: caparison, saddle-cloth (horse blanket)
entries.notes: L 疑作 Gualdrapa（马衣）；H「馬坐」/M bê chê 指马鞍座，与马衣近而不同。

entries.en: to keep, to preserve, to store up
entries.notes: M 首音节 T99 污损；「quang」可读为闽南「囥」（收存），与 chūng（藏）连用。

entries.en: to lay up, to store (grain or household wealth)
entries.notes: H「芬」与储藏义不合，疑原稿讹字；L 末「gr.」缩略（疑 grano）未详，义仅据 L 定夺。

entries.zh: 隐藏、窝藏（隐瞒不使人知）
entries.en: to conceal, to hide (to cover up)
entries.notes: H「厓」与藏匿义不合；M 栏混入西语释义注「un quē encubrir, como escondél」，义仅据 L 定夺。

entries.zh: 怀藏于内；怀孕（如孕妇怀胎）
entries.en: to keep within oneself; to be with child (to carry in the womb)
entries.notes: M 首字母 H/C 存疑，语义由 H 懷 与 L「ut preñada」互证。

entries.en: to store up, to hoard (many things kept)
to accumulate, to lay up (wealth)
entries.notes: M 栏内嵌西语 continuando 及 chūn，chūn 当为「存」之续写。

entries.en: to keep, to preserve
to hide, to conceal; to store away

entries.zh: 收存保管、看管（如看守家宅中的存物）
entries.en: to keep in safekeeping, to hold in store (as a household's goods)
entries.notes: L 有[残]，末句「como laguarda de casa」指看管家宅；M 次音节 toā/hvā 存疑。

entries.en: to keep (a secret), to conceal
entries.notes: M 读法 am/on 存疑，义由 H 隱 与 L「Guardar el secreto」互证。

entries.en: to guard, to keep watch; to hold in custody
entries.notes: L「in enguardia」为「在守卫中」的拉丁化表述，H 押 取押守义。

entries.zh: 把守、执掌（如执法官吏之看守）
entries.en: to hold in custody, to keep charge of (as an officer of justice)
entries.notes: L「como justicia oficial」指以执法官身份看守，H 把 取把持、把守义。

entries.en: to look after, to watch over (a thing)
entries.notes: M「cûa」与 省 常读不合，疑记 看（khòaⁿ）之音，语义由 L「mirar la cosa」定。

entries.en: to keep guard, to stand watch (as a sentinel)
to hold firmly, to stand by (a resolve)
entries.notes: L 有[残]（「fir[me]」），M pê tiā 与 H 把定 相合。

entries.en: to keep the house, to watch over the home
the keeper of a temple or hermitage
entries.notes: L 为动词式「看守庵堂」，H/M 实为名词性人职（庵主），按人职称。

entries.en: temple elder, the old keeper of a shrine
entries.notes: 同 position 18，L 动词式表述对应名词性人职。

entries.zh: 安分守己（安于本分地位）
entries.en: to keep to one's station, to be content in one's lot
entries.notes: L「guardar los per venir a su estado」有缩略（「per」疑 preceptos/para），H 安分 义明。
